name: TinyZKP Changelog and Release Policy
summary: Public release notes, compatibility rules, and release identity metadata for TinyZKP proof receipts, API, MCP, verifier, pricing, evaluation, schemas, and public product metadata.

current_public_release.theme: Proof receipts for agents, APIs, and state transitions
current_public_release.product_boundary: Transparent STARK state-transition proof receipts for supported public templates. Generic private-input zero knowledge, arbitrary zkVM execution, zkML, and chain-specific on-chain verification are not default self-serve claims.
highlights: Published buyer-facing hubs for use cases, comparisons, integrations, proof templates, examples, limits, evaluation, pricing, calculator, and pilot review.

Added machine-readable metadata for MCP tools, MCP marketplace discovery, agent proof policy, integrations, templates, examples, limits, fit finder, evaluation, pricing, calculator guidance, OpenAPI, and schemas.
Added GTM pages for agent platforms, verifiable agent output, and agent audit trails, plus comparison pages for zkVM provers, zkTLS, and blockchain anchoring.
Added commercial packaging for a $5,000 creditable production pilot, a dedicated platform-rollout package from $499/month minimum plus usage, and reserved-capacity review.
Added ROI and business-case worksheet for finance/procurement review, avoided-cost modeling, and pilot payback.
Added Fit Finder for routing buyers and agents between Free, Developer, Pro, Scale, Compute, paid pilot, platform rollout, enterprise, and defer paths.
Clarified the live self-serve product as a transparent STARK state-transition receipt.
Documented release identity endpoints for checking deploy skew across website, API, MCP, SDK examples, and verifier behavior.
Added public release policy guidance for API, MCP, templates, examples, verifier, schemas, evaluation, pricing, calculator, and security surfaces.
compatibility_notes: New response fields are additive by default; clients should ignore fields they do not understand.
Route removals, required-parameter changes, proof-format floors, and verifier acceptance changes require a migration note before public rollout unless the change is an emergency security disablement.
Pricing changes must update /pricing.json and /calculator.json before they are treated as buyer-facing source of truth.
MCP tool changes must update /mcp.json and /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json when they affect discovery, installation, tool names, auth expectations, or response semantics.

breaking_or_sensitive_changes: Proof-format floor or verifier acceptance change
MCP tool removal or input-shape change
Material trust, data-handling, or audit-status change
normal_requirements: Update the relevant machine-readable metadata file
Update the public schema when the file shape changes
Include migration guidance for breaking or sensitive changes
Expose release identity for website, API, and MCP surfaces where applicable
release_policy.emergency_exception: Security disables or abuse-mitigation changes may ship before the normal deprecation window, with a public note added as soon as practical.
